boss: Raptor (rust-raptor), Level 5 Songwindow Heights wave 5 mini-boss, bespoke RaptorBoss.js, 320 HP

runs.result: WIN, Raptor dead at 29s after first sight

moveStats.barrage: seen 1 per run, hit Zed 2/2 hits every time (first move, ~12s after wave start, 0 evaded in 5 runs)
moveStats.bounce_grapple_falcon: never seen in any run (not exercised)

findings.title: Raptor stalls in approach and stops attacking when Zed stays within 120 px
findings.detail: pickRaptorMove (src/enemies/raptorData.js:103-112): barrage is the only move with minRange 0 and is blocked by s.lastId!==id after use; dive/bounce/grapple/falcon need dist>=120/180/250/150. Raptor stays in approach at x4420 vs Zed x4440 from t=24s to 49s with no move. Seed 1, run MB-L5-raptor-solo, probe sampled each second; also visible in MB-L5-raptor-kite (3 moves in 100s). Lets a player stand in his face to neutralise the fight, and makes 4 of 5 canon moves untestable by the hunter.

findings.title: Boss-hunter lost 0 hits dealt vs Raptor (killed by crew grunts) in 2/2 runs; no Raptor-specific evasion in persona, so evade stats are a lower bound
findings.detail: MB-L5-raptor-solo 20-49s, EB-L5-raptor-crew. Zed died to grunt-2/3 hits while parrying them.

findings.title: ?solo does not remove the crew on Level 5 wave 5 (grunt-2..4 still spawn)
findings.detail: MB-L5-raptor-solo probe t=22s. boss5.html strips crew; ArenaScene ?solo does not for this level.

findings.title: Boss intro card holds play ~10 s (agent goal victory) before Raptor fight; Raptor opens with barrage that hits twice
findings.detail: timeline 20.4-30.5s in MB-L5-raptor-solo; verify on video whether the card is skippable.

findings.title: kiter-dodge no-progress 25s flag (suspected persona artifact of passive run, likely the same Raptor stall)

gaps: Persona has no Raptor-specific logic (dive marker sidestep, falcon drop, grapple cable); bounce/grapple/falcon/frenzy never measured
requests: Fix Raptor stall when Zed within minRange of all moves (add a retreat/back-hop or allow non-repeat barrage)
Add Raptor evade logic to boss-hunter in agent.js then rerun
Make ?solo drop the crew on L5 W5
